tools.name: dash_list_instances
tools.description: List accessible instances. Hosted Dash lists member Rebekah instances; local Frog lists its selected local workspace instance.

tools.name: dash_read_instance
tools.description: Read an accessible instance and its permitted activity. Unknown and inaccessible ids both return not_found.

tools.name: dash_read_view
tools.description: Read a bounded instance view with source and freshness metadata. Views not supplied by this instance return an explicit unavailable error.

tools.name: dash_read_frog
tools.description: Read a private read-only Frog task snapshot. Unconfigured sources are unavailable, not zero tasks; source metadata identifies live local or hosted snapshot data.

tools.name: dash_read_audit
tools.description: Read permitted audit events. Hosted Dash uses the account or member instance trail; local Frog uses the selected workspace event log, labelled by source.

tools.name: frog_task_list
tools.description: List tasks filtered by repository, workflow status or assignee. Local workspace selects a configured workspace; hosted workspace selects an accessible instance id (optional when exactly one exists).

tools.name: frog_status
tools.description: Read task status counts for the selected coordination source, optionally filtered by repository. Source and snapshot freshness remain explicit.

tools.name: frog_log_tail
tools.description: Read recent permitted coordination audit events. Local workspace uses Frog's event log; hosted workspace uses the instance's permitted Dash trail, not a claimed copy of Frog's native log.
